title: Enterprise security onboarding checklist and customer-facing compliance playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers frequently ask for a mix of audit artifacts, contractual language, and operational assurances (SOC2/ISO reports, DPA clauses, HIPAA BAAs, GDPR data-mapping) during sales/onboarding. Responses are ad-hoc across CSMs/SEs and engineering, which increases time-to-close and leads to inconsistent commitments.

Goal: Create a single, compact onboarding checklist plus a public-facing playbook for CSMs/SEs that: (1) maps common customer asks to authoritative artifacts (what we can provide), (2) prescribes approved language and exception paths, (3) enumerates engineering prerequisites and estimated lead time, and (4) provides templates and automation points (evidence bundler, preflight checklist in Console). This ticket scopes the PM work to draft the checklist/playbook, get legal/security sign-off, and deliver CSM-ready artifacts and a companion Confluence + GitHub repo of templates.

Scope (this ticket): Product + CSM-facing materials and operational runbook. Engineering work to automate evidence export or Console UI changes will be captured as dependent ENG tickets. Deliverables are described below.
acceptance_criteria: A concise one-page onboarding checklist (PDF + Confluence) that maps 12 common asks (SOC2 Type II report, ISO attestation, DPA template, BAA, data residency options, encryption/KMS, audit logs, subprocessor list, vulnerability disclosure, pen-test summary, access review cadence, incident response SLA) to: what we provide, expected lead time, and known constraints.
A customer-facing playbook (Confluence + single-slide summary) for CSMs/SEs with approved language snippets for sales/legal conversations and a clear exception escalation path.
Legal, Security, and Compliance teams have reviewed and signed off on the playbook (email thread or approval comment recorded in this ticket).
A small repo of templates (DPA excerpt, BAA cover language, SOC2 distribution process doc) is created in GitHub with guidance for when to use each template.
Hand-off package for automation: minimal spec document (API endpoints, fields, and evidence types) is delivered to ENG as dependent ticket(s).
Two CSMs and two Solutions Engineers complete a 30-minute walkthrough and sign off that the playbook materially reduces ambiguity compared to current practice (feedback recorded).
deliverables: Customer-facing compliance playbook (Confluence page + one-slide summary)
Template bundle in GitHub (DPA snippets, BAA language, sample audit request response)
Engineering intake spec for evidence bundler/API
CSM/SE runbook + training notes and recording
